rules.rationale: Expands the named loopBody proof term into the exact sequence of statement constructors used by the program loop.
Expands the named sortEvenBody proof term into the exact constructor-level body of sort_even.
Defines the named sortEvenClosure value from its parameter, body proof term, and defining environment.
Specializes ordinary execution-time parameter binding for the singleton l parameter in a fresh plain function frame.
Defines the even-index subsequence summary using the supplied slice start, stop, step, length, and build helpers.
Defines the odd-index subsequence summary using the supplied slice start, stop, step, length, and build helpers.
Defines the base case of the pairedVS recurrence when no odd-index values remain.
Defines the recursive pairedVS summary by emitting the indexed even value and untouched odd value before recurring.
Defines the base case of the advancedIndex recurrence on an empty iterator suffix.
Defines the recursive advancedIndex summary by incrementing once per remaining odd value.
Defines the trailing even-values summary as the supplied slice operation beginning at the odd-subsequence length.
Defines the final functional summary by concatenating paired even/odd values with the possible trailing even suffix.
Adds the right-identity law for the pre-existing valSeqConcat operation; it is present during compilation and is not separately proved by prove.sh.
Adds associativity for the pre-existing valSeqConcat operation as a simplification fact; no earlier exact proof of this rule appears in prove.sh.
Adds a map-membership simplification asserting that the distinct named local keys do not affect membership of "$cells"; it is compiled before and trusted by the proofs.
Defines verification-time observation of a returned heap reference by dereferencing it to the stored value.
Defines verification-time observation of an already direct non-reference value as that same value.
